<thought>To generate a retrosynthetic route with a single carbonyl‑ene step, I will look for a template whose forward reaction converts a ketone and an alkene into a five‑membered cyclic allylic alcohol (the target). In the retro direction this means breaking the C–O bond of the alcohol and the newly formed C–C bond, and forming a C=O (ketone) and a C=C double bond. I will search the template catalog for such a transformation.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
  "molecule_smiles": "[CH2:1]=[C:2]([c:3]1[cH:4][cH:5][cH:6][cH:7][cH:8]1)[C@@H:9]1[CH2:10][CH2:11][CH2:12][C@@:13]1([OH:14])[C:15]([F:16])([F:17])[F:18]",
  "functional_groups_broken": ["hydroxyl"],
  "functional_groups_formed": ["ketone"],
  "bonds_order_changed": ["C=C (1.0->2.0)", "C=O (2.0->1.0)"],
  "limit": 5
}
